related.title: SQLite WAL：讀取快照與 checkpoint
related.titleEn: SQLite WAL: reader snapshots and checkpoints
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付樹圖與鍵範圍查核；若使用真正SQLite再另記page_size與EXPLAIN結果。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the tree and range checks; actual SQLite experiments additionally record page_size and EXPLAIN output. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 列reader start/end與writer commit序號，畫read mark與checkpoint watermark；實際WAL header不納入payload模型；checkpoint不會截掉檔案前綴，重設／截斷另受讀者限制。
related.differenceEn: Trace reader starts/ends and writer commit sequences, drawing read marks and checkpoint watermarks; exclude WAL headers from the payload model. Checkpointing does not truncate a prefix, and reset/truncation has reader constraints.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
B-tree以排序鍵分隔子樹；實際SQLite頁格式含header與cell指標，不能把理想fanout當固定產品數值。
本課數值核對：100**3 = 1000000 entries；另一項核對：ceil(log(1000000)/log(100)) = 3 levels。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

WAL讀者保留開始讀取時的可見邊界；checkpoint不能任意越過仍需舊狀態的讀者。長讀取會影響回收。
本課數值核對：100*4096 = 409600 total_page_payload_B；另一項核對：(100-40)*4096 = 245760 uncheckpointed_page_payload_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
B-trees separate subtrees with ordered keys; SQLite pages include headers and cell pointers, so ideal fanout is not a fixed product number.
Numeric audit: 100**3 = 1000000 entries; second audit: ceil(log(1000000)/log(100)) = 3 levels. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

WAL readers retain a visibility boundary from read start; checkpointing cannot disregard readers needing older state. Long readers affect reclamation.
Numeric audit: 100*4096 = 409600 total_page_payload_B; second audit: (100-40)*4096 = 245760 uncheckpointed_page_payload_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

訊息selector與receiver的實際類別決定method lookup；繼承鏈查找與直接欄位讀取是不同動作。
